answer: Proof-of-Ridge Microtask Lattice. Each identity must complete a randomized sequence of verifiable microtasks whose answers are generated from a shared jade ledger of prior work, so new keys cannot shortcut the queue. An agent earns eligibility only by sustaining a distinct fable of task outputs across sessions. Attackers pay per identity: solving each microtask costs real compute and latency, and duplicated answers collapse onto one ridge value, forfeiting all clones at once.
